acceptanceCriteria: A regression test swaps --map for a FIFO after the type check (or opens a FIFO path directly) and LoadMap refuses promptly with a stable code instead of blocking.
LoadMap reuses the gh658 no-follow, non-blocking open helper rather than a new copy.
body: Suspected, not reproduced. Found in Codex review of the gh658 lane (issue 658, V1-0957) on 2026-10-07, Core 1.0.0-rc.2 build 360, Tasks build.202. appmap.LoadMap (internal/appmap/project.go, V1-0956 / issue 657, branch claude/gh657 6a1dab87) checks --map with Lstat and then calls os.Open, so a FIFO swapped in between the two calls makes the read block. Expected: a bounded, non-blocking refusal. The gh658 receipt loader already uses a no-follow, non-blocking open with size/mtime rechecks (internal/appmap/open_unix.go) that can be reused.
title: Suspected: appmap LoadMap can block on a FIFO swapped in between Lstat and open of --map
